name: John Bozeman
role: Montana trail guide in J. S. Warn's Lost Cabin memoir
bio: John Bozeman appears in J. S. Warn's serialized memoir 'The Lost Cabin Gold Mines,' printed in summer 1885. Warn recalled him coming from Virginia City, Mont., to guide a wagon train on a short cut to the Alder Gulch mines, and later finding his camp on the Big Horn River.

moments.label: Recalled guiding emigrants toward Alder Gulch
